reasons.action: The brief explicitly requests a new temporal motion — the car pulling out of the bay onto a wet street — which overrides the reference vehicle's static presentation.
reasons.medium: The medium owner is pinned to the reference; the request authorizes no change from the live-action rendering.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is requested; the observed carbon fibre body of the black car is retained.
reasons.lighting: 'Wet street' names a location and surface condition, not an illuminating source, direction or visible light quality, so reference lighting stands.
reasons.framing: No camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or movement is specified; duration, aspect ratio and the described motion do not constitute framing instructions.
reasons.palette: The wet street is incidental scene setting, not a requested color palette, so the reference's observed palette governs.
